en.answer:
The Spell and Trap Cards targeted by the effect of <<6218>> can be activated in a chain to its activation.

Also, in that case, if only 1 of the 2 targeted Spell and Trap Cards remains face-down at the time of the resolution of the effect of <<6218>>, only the set card becomes unable to be activated by the effect of <<6218>>.
en.question:
Can the 2 Spell and Trap Cards targeted by <<6218>> be activated in a chain to its activation?

Also, in that case, if 1 of the 2 targeted Spell and Trap Cards remains set, how does this resolve?
en.title: Can the 2 Spell and Trap Cards targeted by <<6218>> be activated in a chain to its activation?  Also, in that case, if 1 of the 2 targeted Spell and Trap Cards remains set, how does this resolve?

ja.answer:
「<<6218>>」の発動にチェーンして、対象となった魔法・罠カードを発動する事はできます。

また、それによって、「<<6218>>」の効果処理時に、対象となった2枚のうちセットされた状態の魔法・罠カードが1枚のみになっている場合、セットされた状態のカード1枚のみが「<<6218>>」の効果によって、発動できない状態になります。
